# vastdata_iam_role_credentials (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_iam_role_credentials" "vastdb_iam_role_credentials" {
  iam_role_id = vastdata_iam_role.vastdb_iam_role.id
  access_key  = "93LVOYW0R1K8M5WH8R8F"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_key` (String)
- `iam_role_id` (Number) ID of the IAM role

### Optional

- `key_expiration_sec` (Number)
- `session_policy` (String)
- `username` (String)
